name_en: Itadaki — raw rice and vegetables stuffed into a whole fried tofu pouch
summary_ja: 大きな三角油揚げに生米と野菜を詰め、だし汁でじっくり炊き上げる西部地域の郷土食。明治中頃、境港市の寺の住職が福井の精進料理からヒントを得たのが始まりと伝わり、綿入れの着物に見立てて「ののこ飯」とも呼ばれる。
summary_en: Raw rice and vegetables are packed into a large triangular fried tofu pouch and slow-simmered in stock, a dish from western Tottori. Said to have begun in the mid-Meiji era when a Sakaiminato temple priest borrowed the idea from shojin cooking in Fukui, it's also called "nonoko meshi" for its resemblance to a padded winter kimono.
source_title: いただき 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Daisen Okowa — soy-seasoned sticky rice steamed with mountain vegetables
summary_ja: しいたけやごぼう、鶏肉などをもち米に炊き込む、大山山麓のしょうゆ味おこわ。かつて僧兵が戦勝祈願で炊いたのが始まりとも伝わり、大山寺の牛馬市で振る舞われた後、祭りやもてなしの席に受け継がれてきたという。
summary_en: Shiitake, burdock, and chicken are cooked into sticky rice seasoned with soy, a dish from the foot of Mount Daisen. Said to trace back to warrior monks preparing it before battle to pray for victory, it was later served at the horse-and-cattle market by Daisen-ji temple and carried on into festivals and hospitality since.
source_title: 大山おこわ 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Dondoroke Meshi — rice mixed with tofu fried loud enough to sound like thunder
summary_ja: 熱した油で豆腐を炒める「バリバリ」という音を雷（方言でどんどろけ）に見立てた、鳥取東部・中部の炊き込みご飯。各集落にあった豆腐小屋で自家製の大豆から豆腐をつくっていた頃の、地元産づくしの一品と伝わる。
summary_en: Named for the crackling sound of tofu frying in hot oil, likened to thunder — "dondoroke" in local dialect — this is a rice dish from eastern and central Tottori. It's said to date to when each hamlet had its own tofu shack turning home-grown soybeans into tofu, using nothing but local ingredients.
source_title: どんどろけ飯 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Igai Meshi — mussels foraged by ama divers, cooked into rice
summary_ja: 山陰で唯一海女が活動する鳥取市青谷町夏泊で、海女がとってきたイガイ（イガイ科の二枚貝）を炊き込みご飯にする。海女の仕事が始まる6月頃からつくられ、磯の香りが口いっぱいに広がる夏の始まりを告げる一皿という。
summary_en: In Natsudomari, part of Tottori City's Aoya district and the only place in the San'in region where ama divers still work, mussels the divers bring up are cooked into rice. Made from around June, when the divers' season begins, it fills the mouth with the scent of the shore and marks the start of summer.
source_title: いがい飯 鳥取県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
